_meta.title: Phase 6 M4 — D-027/D-060 idempotency conformance matrix
_meta.note: Frozen expected outcomes. test_phase6_notion_m4_conformance.py executes EVERY row against BOTH the local JSON EventStore and the live PostgreSQL canonical store. Changing an expected value here is a contract change and must ship with a decision-record amendment.

rows.given: one status_changed delivery ingested successfully; the byte-identical delivery arrives again
one status_changed delivery ingested; the page's revision marker changes (new revision, same transition semantics)
one delivery ingested; a delivery with the SAME key (page+type+marker) but different transition content arrives
the page moves Draft -> Review -> Draft -> Review with a distinct revision marker per revision
a delivery fails (illegal transition); the SAME marker is offered again next cycle; then the source is corrected (new marker, legal transition)
a cycle ingests an event; the engine process restarts (fresh engine, same durable cursor file); the page is unchanged
a status_changed delivery references a state outside the D-060 machine
a status_changed delivery with NO revision marker on any candidate field, delivered twice with different last_edited_time metadata
